name: build_3d_knowledge_graph_data
summary: Scan local markdown files and generate structured graph data JSON/JS file for visualization.
steps: Run build.py in Python 3 scanning target markdown notes directory
Extract title, parent folder, wikilinks, and 700-character excerpt for each file
Write formatted node and connection link structures to viewer/graph-data.js
jarvis_use: Parse local vault markdown files into a structured graph dataset for visual memory mapping.

name: serve_3d_brain_ui
summary: Host a local web dashboard rendering a 3D interactive force-directed graph of system notes.
steps: Create index.html using 3d-force-graph library from CDN
Launch server.py binding local IP on port 4719
Render force-directed 3D node network based on graph-data.js payload
jarvis_use: Serve an interactive 3D visual neural graph dashboard for memory navigation on localhost.

name: keyword_overlap_note_scoring
summary: Score and retrieve local note excerpts using keyword overlap matching for prompt context injection.
steps: Receive user prompt text at /chat POST endpoint
Scan indexed note database for keyword overlap against query terms
Extract and rank top relevant note excerpts
Pass ranked context excerpts into Anthropic API payload
jarvis_use: Fetch relevant local note excerpts based on keyword overlap matching to augment Jarvis responses.

name: buffered_web_speech_recognition
summary: Buffer browser speech input with a silence timer to prevent sentence truncation during pauses.
steps: Initialize webkitSpeechRecognition instance in browser UI
Capture intermediate speech-to-text transcript events
Start a timer set to FINISH_MS = 900ms upon receiving intermediate text
Reset timer and append text if new speech events arrive before 900ms elapses
Dispatch full accumulated transcript to backend /chat endpoint only when 900ms elapses without speech
jarvis_use: Eliminate premature sentence truncation in Jarvis speech recognition by enforcing a 900ms pause buffer.

name: silent_testing_mode_flag
summary: Check URL parameter flag to bypass browser text-to-speech output during automated or silent testing.
steps: Inspect window.location search parameters inside core speak() output function
If parameter ?mute=1 is present, log response text to UI without calling speechSynthesis API
If parameter is absent, synthesize spoken audio output normally
jarvis_use: Allow silent debugging and prompt testing of Jarvis interface without continuous audio output.

name: tab_sharing_canvas_frame_snapshot
summary: Capture single video frames from active screen share streams for token-efficient vision processing.
steps: Initiate tab sharing stream via getDisplayMedia browser API
Listen for visual user query while tab stream is active
Render current video frame onto an off-screen HTML canvas element
Export canvas buffer as JPEG/PNG base64 image data payload
POST image payload and question text to /see backend endpoint for LLM vision analysis
jarvis_use: Inspect and answer questions about visible browser tabs using low-cost single frame snapshots.

name: multilingual_voice_switch_routing
summary: Route response voice synthesis into a selected target language while preserving English speech input.
steps: Select target output language via UI chip toggle or voice command
Set active target language variable in application state
Inject target language output directive into LLM system prompt instructions
Match and bind Web Speech API window.speechSynthesis to corresponding native localized voice profile
Synthesize output audio in target language while receiving English voice input
jarvis_use: Allow Jarvis to speak in any chosen language while understanding natural English voice input.

name: retell_ai_phone_agent_integration
summary: Integrate Retell AI telephony agents with dedicated phone numbers for voice and SMS interactions.
steps: Configure agent profiles on retellai.com dashboard
Assign domain-specific system prompts (e.g., Jarvis - Hotline)
Link virtual phone number (+15105183164) to active agent instance
Route call events and text interactions through Retell AI execution pipeline
jarvis_use: Extend Jarvis capabilities to answer inbound phone calls and send SMS notifications via Retell AI.

name: google_calendar_tool_execution
summary: Query scheduled calendar events using tool integrations and synthesize spoken summary responses.
steps: Receive spoken query requesting schedule details for a specific date
Invoke Google Calendar API/MCP integration to fetch events for requested timestamp
Format event data payload into structured text
Pass schedule text to LLM and synthesize response via target language TTS voice
jarvis_use: Enable Jarvis to inspect Google Calendar schedules and read upcoming agenda items aloud.
